Adverse Effects and Precautions As for Phenytoin, p.495. Severe cardiovascular reactions, sometimes fatal, have been reported after intravenous doses of fosphenytoin. Therefore, continuous monitoring of ECG, blood pres- sure, and respiratory function is recommended during the infusion, and the patient should be kept under ob- servation for at least 30 minutes after the end of the in- fusion.
